item.title: Cartel terror camps where new recruits forced to cut off fingers and eat human flesh
item.description: The Jalisco New Generation Cartel has expanded rapidly across Mexico in recent years, and its members have been known to carry out brutal acts of violence to intimidate their rivals
item.author: Tom Towers,Jane Lavender

media:content.media:description: A drug cartel in Mexico is forcing members into cannibalism after videos online have emerged which show gang members eating body parts of enemies.Footage uploaded by The Jalisco New Generation Cartel shows one of its members eating a rival's heart straight from his chest in Zacatecas state last month, the Daily Mail reports.The CJNG gang is believed to be led by Nemesio 'El Mencho' Oseguera Cervantes and the group has become one of the most dominant cartels in the area, operating in at least 35 states across Mexico and Puerto Rico.
